line: Build and deploy applications with managed hosting and databases.

free.text: Free plan advertised; ongoing limits unclear

work.math: Earth Base plan: 750,000 toman a month listed; 759,930 for 730 hours. Up to 20 builds a day, 5 minutes each. 100 GB of traffic is subject to fair use. Tax and the full total are not confirmed.
Jupiter Base with 1 vCPU and 2 GB: 2,300,000 toman a month listed; 2,331,620 for 730 hours. API capacity is untested. The 5-minute build cap, fair-use traffic and tax still need checking.
5,250,000 toman a month listed; 5,322,430 for 730 hours. 7 copies of 10 GB = 70 GB, while the price data says backup capacity is 180 GB and the docs say 45 GB. Tax and traffic are not confirmed.
